LanguageData.RT_M10_MainBattleTank_Blueprint.label: M10 Booker
LanguageData.RT_M10_MainBattleTank_Blueprint.descript:
A 3rd generation Light MBT equipped with an 120mm gun, without APS due to export restrictions on trade fleet, but got free firepower upgrades in exchange.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Gunner x2, Commander x1
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel

<color=#b0e0e6>CE Ammo:</color> 
120mmCannon（Main Cannon）
50BMG（Support MG）
7.62x51mmNATO（Coaxial MG）
